signals.text: The Golden Threads for our school are community, belonging, special and love.
All maintained schools must provide religious education and daily collective worship for all pupils and promote their spiritual, moral and cultural development.

Alongside this Bidbury Junior School has regular visitors from the community, assemblies and workshops to supplement the Religious Education curriculum and to support children’s knowledge and understanding of other faiths.
